title: Measure configuration and auth resolution on both platforms, default and overridden
statement: Establish which configuration-locating variables 0.84.4 consults to find its authentication store and custom-model registry, under both default directories and an explicitly overridden one, on Windows and POSIX; and confirm a restricted child carrying only those variables resolves the same store as its parent. Record the answer to QST-0029 as the measured base allowlist.
